items: Restaurant and F&B brands often want review management built for their industry, with categories that match how guests talk about food, service and atmosphere.
Look for one dashboard that collects reviews from every platform and location, so your team can monitor and reply without switching between sites.
Sentiment analysis matters most when it shows what drives positive and negative reviews, where incidents happen and how satisfaction shifts over time.
Fast follow-up, such as a short SMS survey after the visit, helps you catch and fix problems before they turn into public reviews.
Momos brings reviews, surveys, social and delivery feedback into one Unified Inbox, where its AI agent Alfie writes on-brand replies and dashboards show issues by location.
